archive_verification: External postpackage receipt binds complete archive and exact literal-restored reanalysis; it is deliberately outside the archive it verifies.
claim_limits: Qualification screen on three fixed historical small multimodal models, not an LLM-scale benchmark.
Four update schedules measure within-model training variation; they are not four independent models.
Fourteen retained calibration values supplement the readout. No claim of a context-free 12-dimensional Markov sufficient state.
Source disjointness covers the complete recorded V2/V3/V4 identities, not unknown pretraining or writers.
The fixed V3 Q_ref targets refer to the frozen reference continuation, not the eventual adaptive policy or an optimal value function.
Final/runtime/production and original substantive B03-B07 claims remain unestablished without their own evidence.

persistence.requires: Explicit user-authored named archive/report files and ChatGPT Library destination.

stop_reason: The single registered panel-origin candidate failed both incremental-gain checks. The fixed failure policy stops final/runtime access and forbids outcome-driven retuning or resampling.
